explanation: OEIS A109908 (greatest prime of the form k(n−k) − 1, else 0): 'Conjecture: a(n) > 0 for n > 3.' The formal a takes the sup of the primes among k(n−k) − 1 for 1 ≤ k ≤ n/2 (enough by the symmetry k ↔ n−k; k = 0 or n gives −1, never prime), with sup ∅ = 0. The statement ∀ n > 3, a(n) > 0 matches. Faithful.
